caption: The drawing depicts two metal spoons, each illustrated in a horizontal orientation and rendered with grayscale pencil shading. The top spoon is shown facing up with its bowl on the left and the handle extending to the right; there are small marks or engravings visible on the handle, including the label "AB" at the end and some smaller symbols closer to the bowl. The bottom spoon is viewed from above, displaying the curvature and depth of the bowl and the gentle tapering of the handle. Below the two main spoon illustrations is a smaller, inset technical drawing that includes two outline views of the spoon (side and top) along with measurements, indicating a length of 8 inches and bowl dimensions of 2 3/8 inches by 1 3/8 inches. The paper is light tan, and the rectangular border encloses all elements, with the text "SCALE 1/4 = 1" written near the technical drawing. The drawing is signed "C. Winter" on the lower right.
title: Silver Spoon
